text:
maria: Quick callout — Galileo-Lite is GA on Hosted API. Rolling out over the next 48h starting 10:00 PT. TL;DR: smaller memory footprint, ~30% lower token cost for many chat workloads, streaming + tool-calling enabled by default on the new endpoint. Docs + migration notes below. Canaries will go to early adopters first; full ramp if metrics look good.

maria: Key details:
- endpoint: POST /v2/galileo-lite/generate (compatible with existing chat params)
- streaming: chunked responses + tool-calls supported (same function-calling semantics)
- perf: median p95 latency target same as other hosted models; we expect cost savings on average workload mixes
- console: new route-level dashboard (latency/token breakdown) and a "Galileo Lite" model badge

maria: Example quickstart curl:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/galileo-lite/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"Summarize the release notes","stream":true}'
```

adeel: Question — does this change pricing or quotas? Are existing rate limits/quotas applied the same way?

maria: Pricing: Galileo-Lite uses the hosted "lite" pricing tier — same quota system applies. Customers on committed Dedicated contracts are unaffected unless they opt into the lite variant. We will publish an itemized pricing table in the billing docs; temporary promo credits pushed to early adopters.

eng-lead-sam: Rollout plan for ops: 5% traffic (canary) -> 25% -> 100% over 48h if errors/latency stable. Monitoring hooks set: error-rate > 0.5% for 10m or p95 latency increase > 20% triggers automatic rollback and an incident channel notification. Please ensure SLO dashboards include the new model route.

docs-anna: I updated the quickstart and migration guide at https://internal.docs/redwood/galileo-lite. Can someone drop 2-3 bullet points (customer facing) for the changelog? I added the curl above but want short marketing-friendly bullets.

maria: Changelog bullets suggestion: 
- "Galileo-Lite (GA): same dev experience, ~30% lower inference cost for common chat patterns."
- "Streaming and tool-calling enabled by default on the new endpoint."
- "New route-level observability in Redwood Console."
Feel free to edit.

ops-bot: deploy-event: Galileo-Lite v1.0 started deployment at 2177777800. us-west-2 shard: 12/12 nodes healthy. Canary traffic: 5%.

oncall-jen: Oncall here — watching error-rate and token-cost dashboards. Runbook link: https://runbooks/redwood/model-rollouts. Will post alerts if anything crosses thresholds.

maria: Awesome, thanks. If you see significant regressions, please escalate to #incidents and tag me + eng-lead-sam. Will post the external GA blog and support FAQ once we hit 100% ramp. :tada:

adeel: LGTM

eng-lead-sam: Noted. I'll add the new route to synthetic checks and prober.

maria: Closing note — deprecation: legacy /v1/chat-toolcall will remain supported for 90 days; we'll post migration guide reminders to affected customers.

maria: Thanks everyone!
